title: AAPS 3.0.0.2 Dash Pod Activation problem
symptom: User is unable to activate a new Dash pod using AAPS 3.0.0.2 on a Samsung A21 phone with Android 12. After multiple retries, activation fails with error: 'Generic error: java.lang.illegalStateException: Trying to set Bluetooth Address to E2:D9:61:24:51:E0, but it is already set to CA:C8:61:24:51:E0'.
cause: According to maintainer Theodoor, the issue is likely due to older Pod firmware versions distributed in Canada and the US, combined with Android 11/12, where specific phones are unable to 'see' the DASH Pod. The error suggests AAPS is seeing an unknown DASH Pod in the neighborhood with a different Bluetooth address.
fix: No definitive fix. Maintainer suggests resetting the Bluetooth app (clear cache and memory, force close, reboot) and ensuring no other DASH Pods are nearby. However, he states this is Pod/Phone hardware related and there is no solution; user may try different phone hardware.
evidence_quote: We found Pods running older Firmware versions are still distributed in CA and the US. We have reports from users running Android version 11 and/or 12 experiencing the problem where specific phones are unable to "see" the DASH Pod.
